# Lab Inventory Management System

A lightweight, production-ready web application for tracking laboratory
inventory — apparatus, equipment, reagents, chemicals, and consumables —
with an append-only audit trail, SOP-aligned stock status, expiry and
service tracking, and Excel import/export.

Built for laboratories that need something better than a spreadsheet but
don't need the overhead of a full LIMS.

---

## Features

- **Five SOP sections** — Apparatus, Equipment, Reagent, Chemical, Consumable
- **Master Inventory fields** — Inventory ID, description, manufacturer,
  lot/serial, opening qty, unit, location, received date, expiry date,
  min/reorder levels, critical flag, condition, service due, unit value,
  responsible person, notes
- **Auto-calculated fields** — Qty In, Qty Out, Current Qty, Stock Status,
  Days to Expiry, Expiry Status, Service Status, Current Value
- **Append-only transaction log** — every RECEIVE, ISSUE / USE, TRANSFER,
  RETURN, QUARANTINE, RELEASE, DISPOSE, and ADJUSTMENT is recorded with
  timestamp, user, and reference. Transactions are never edited or deleted.
- **Auto-archive** — items at zero stock are hidden from section lists but
  preserved in the system, and reappear automatically when new stock arrives
- **Area-based filtering** — Biochemical Analysis, Microbio 2, Preparation
  Lab, Preparation Room, Microbiology Lab Equipment, Microbiology Lab
- **Import** — upload an Excel or CSV file. Two shapes auto-detected:
  - SOP shape (Inventory ID + Opening Qty + Min Level)
  - Snapshot shape (Item Description + Quantity + Units) — sheet names
    become areas, categories map to the SOP list
- **Export** — two formats:
  - Native (one sheet per category + Transactions)
  - SOP-compatible (Master Inventory + Stock Movements matching the
    controlled workbook column layout)
- **Multi-user** — viewer / technician / admin roles, Argon2-hashed
  passwords, CSRF-protected forms, rate-limited login
- **Audit log** — every write is recorded with user, IP, action, and
  timestamp

---

## Tech Stack

| Layer | Choice |
|---|---|
| Language | Python 3.12 |
| Framework | Flask 3 |
| ORM | SQLAlchemy 2 |
| Dev database | SQLite |
| Production database | PostgreSQL (Neon free tier) |
| Auth | Flask-Login + Argon2 |
| Forms | Flask-WTF (CSRF protection) |
| Excel | pandas + openpyxl |
| Server | Gunicorn |
| Hosting | Render (free tier) |

## Local Development

### Prerequisites

- Python 3.12
- Git

### Setup

```bash
git clone https://github.com/YOUR-USERNAME/lab-inventory.git
cd lab-inventory

python -m venv .venv

# Windows
.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1

# macOS / Linux
source .venv/bin/activate

pip install -r requirements.txt
